stem: Which statement best describes the location of the sun in the Milky Way galaxy?

options.label: A
options.text: The sun is located in the center of a spiral-shaped galaxy.

options.label: B
options.text: The sun is located off the center of an elliptical-shaped galaxy.

options.label: C
options.text: The sun is located on an arm of a spiral-shaped galaxy.

options.label: D
options.text: The sun is located on an arm of an elliptical-shaped galaxy.
